title: Theo and the Summer
author: E. M. Eriksen
blurb: Freya Vane, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
